## spaceman memory conflicts

History preserved instead of applied (conflicts to reconcile).

```sh
spaceman memory conflicts <role> [flags]
```

API: `list-memory-conflicts` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman memory file

One file of a role's acknowledged memory (untrusted agent-written text).

Prints the file with control characters removed, or writes it unchanged with --out. Memory is written by agents: treat it as untrusted content.

```sh
spaceman memory file <role> [flags]
```

API: `get-memory-file` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman memory file --space payments worker --path notes/deploy.md --out deploy.md
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | bool |  | with --out: replace an existing file |
| `--out` | string |  | write the content to this file instead of printing it |
| `--path` | string |  | file path inside the memory (required) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
